lines.text: Joab refuses to let Ahimaaz carry the news because the king's son is dead, so he sends a Cushite instead.
David sits between the two gates while a watchman on the roof sees a man running alone and says it is Ahimaaz.
Ahimaaz bows before the king and says Absalom is dead, since he saw the tumult and knew exactly what it was.

wrong_details.wrong: Ahimaaz says Absalom is dead and knew what the tumult was
wrong_details.true: Ahimaaz says he saw a great tumult but does not know what it was

lines.text: The Cushite tells David that Absalom is like the king's enemies, and David goes up to the King's Valley to weep.
Joab tells the grieving king to go out and comfort his servants, so David gets up and sits in the gate.
